g.text: Latencies describe successful requests only. Repetitions are not pooled. Outstanding client requests are not a server queue measurement.
baseline-A: r1-p1-v0 / 2026-10-01T19-53-48.853Z_rps-1_c77c2c8c; 0 failed; p95, p99 unavailable
baseline-B: r1-p1-v1 / 2026-10-01T19-55-36.562Z_rps-1_9d105bb1; 0 failed; p95, p99 unavailable
Limitation: Each capacity classification describes a fixed observation window. Sustainable capacity requires repeated longer boundary trials.
Limitation: Tails are conditional on successful requests. p95 requires 200 successes and p99 requires 1000; sample size does not guarantee precision.
Limitation: Paired uncertainty resamples independent trial blocks, not individual requests. Fewer than five pairs remains inconclusive.
Limitation: No validated matching accuracy scores are supplied. Accuracy versus throughput and random-scoring controls remain pending with the accuracy
Limitation: Model batching, exact KV-cache allocation and any new prefill/decode CUDA event boundaries require the serving owner. Optional HTTP token
observations remain unavailable when their wrapper contract checks fail.
Limitation: Service wall time is not CUDA event time. Client minus service is an unattributed residual, not measured server queue time.
Limitation: Results apply to the declared workload, observed output lengths and recorded instrumentation. Claims about longer outputs, mixed traffic or
other instrumentation settings require corresponding completed matched studies.
